risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantitative detail, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and conditional language regarding demand, crew utilization, project timing, and commodity prices. Risk tone is moderately negative because utilization remained historically low, operating costs exceeded revenue, and results remain highly exposed to volatile oil and gas activity, although fourth-quarter and early-2023 activity improved.
